offence_note: Assault (charges not named; three prior assault convictions noted)
sentence_quote: The appellant Guy Lafleur also appeals his sentence of three years in prison.
note: Only Guy Lafleur's sentence appealed; offence named only as an assault.

offence_note: Constructing building without permit, Building Code Act
sentence_quote: I dismiss the appeal of Mira Vista Apartments Ltd. as against sentence.
note: Corporate offender; fine reduced by trial judge because safety requirements were met; guilty plea made late.

sentence_quote: On this offence you will be sentenced to a term of 18 months. This sentence will be a conditional sentence.
note: Conditional sentence with house arrest conditions (curfew 8pm-5am, weekends at residence).

offence_note: Sexual offences against a female complainant, position of trust
co_offenders: R.V.: sentence also varied to time served
sentence_quote: Accordingly, we would grant leave to appeal sentence and vary the sentences of each appellant to time served.
note: Effective sentence just over eight years; offences inferred as sexual; enhanced credit 2:1 for pre-trial custody.

offence_note: Firearms-related counts and marihuana and cocaine possession
sentence_quote: I will enter sentences on count one for three years concurrent, count two for one year concurrent, court three for one year concurrent, count four for two years concurrent, counts five and six for twelve years each concurrent
note: Counts not named; 12 years concurrent plus 30 and 60 days consecutive; credit 1:1 from April 17, 2011, length not stated; joint submission.

offence_note: Occupying vehicle knowing restricted firearm was in it
sentence_quote: I am sentencing you to 24 months in custody for this offence, to which you have pleaded guilty.
note: Joint submission; s.109 ban 10 years; victim surcharge waived; DNA order not imposed.

offence_note: Attempted murder of police officers during standoff
sentence_quote: I sentence you to serve a jail sentence of four years or 1,460 days.
note: Four-year mandatory minimum; probation includes psychiatric treatment through Forensic Psychiatric Services (non-residential); victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Attempted murder and break and enter during home invasion
sentence_quote: For the sentence of attempted murder I impose a sentence of 6 years imprisonment.
note: Break and enter 2 years concurrent; credit 90 days remand plus 90 days for house arrest; offender stopped attack and called 911.

offence_note: Sexual assault and transmitting child pornography
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal and increase the sentence to 2 ½ years for the sexual assault and one year consecutive for transmitting child pornography, less time served credited at 4 ½ days.
note: Credit 4.5 days; three years probation from trial sentence assumed to stand; mental health mitigation rejected on appeal.

offence_note: Attempted murder and other charges from nightclub shooting
sentence_quote: the sentence imposed of 13 years imprisonment less 1 for 1 credit for time served.
note: Other charges not specified; credit length not stated; s. 743.6 delayed parole.

sentence_quote: The five month sentence imposed was fit in all of the circumstances of this offence and this offender.
